ticker_news.title: Will Intel Shock the World in 2026?
ticker_news.description: Intel stock surged 80% in 2025 under new CEO Lip-Bu Tan, with market cap still significantly below AI peers at $173B. The article argues Intel could see major breakthroughs in 2026 through increased fab utilization, improved margins, advanced 18A node technology including backside power delivery, and potential external customer wins for its foundry business.
ticker_news.author: Billy Duberstein

QQQ.title: Forget Stocks: This S&P 500 ETF Is Poised for Explosive Growth.
QQQ.description: The Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) is positioned for strong growth due to its heavy concentration in tech and AI-exposed companies like Nvidia, Apple, and Microsoft, while maintaining diversified exposure across financials, healthcare, and industrials. With an ultra-low expense ratio of 0.03% and balanced sector allocation, VOO offers investors access to growth potential from the AI boom while providing downside protection if market leadership shifts.
QQQ.author: David Dierking
